result.title: JEPAhead: From Inpainting to Causal Forecasting for Urban Driving
result.summary: We fine-tune a pre-trained V-JEPA1 predictor from bidirectional latent inpainting to action-free causal forecasting while keeping the encoder frozen. Using contiguous past observations, horizon-aligned targets, and group-level causal attention, the model forecasts eight future token groups, corresponding to sixteen frames, in one forward pass. On CARLA Town12, it retrieves the correct future among 591 candidates in 69.0% of cases, compared with 55.3% for persistence, with greater gains at longer horizons and on tokens exhibiting greater change. It also outperforms a compact predictor trained from scratch with six times fewer parameters. Semantic analysis indicates driving-relevant information in predicted features: a fixed linear probe trained on real encoder tokens achieves 0.16 mIoU on patches undergoing semantic-class changes, versus 0.13 for persistence. Vehicle-conditioned retrieval improves over persistence by 15 percentage points at the longest horizon. Pixel-space evaluation shows modest L1 gains but little improvement under LPIPS, motivating direct evaluation through latent and semantic measures alongside an oracle reconstruction reference. These findings support further investigation of latent forecasting for driving perception, while downstream utility remains unverified.

AI.brief_summary: 论文冻结 V-JEPA 编码器，将预训练预测器由双向 latent inpainting 微调为基于连续过去观测的因果预测，一次前向输出对应 16 帧的 8 组未来 token，并用候选检索、语义线性探针与像素指标评估预测质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「检索命中率＋固定线性探针」衡量 latent 是否携带任务必要信息，可供核查 LVR 中预测状态的内容保真度，group-level 因果注意力与 horizon 对齐目标也可能对预测式工作区训练有线索；但任务是驾驶视频预测，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。
